candidate.text: Change in cert expiry metrics: `rootCertExpiryTimestamp` and `certChainExpiryTimestamp` no longer record a negative number for expired certificate/certificate chains. This was never the actual behavior, but the docs are now updated to reflect the actual behavior. Users who relied on this behavior should check the signs of `rootCertExpirySeconds` and `certChainExpirySeconds` instead.

evidence.excerpt:
- title: Change in cert expiry metrics
    content: |
      `rootCertExpiryTimestamp` and `certChainExpiryTimestamp` no longer record a negative number for expired certificate/certificate chains.
      This was never the actual behavior, but the docs are now updated to reflect the actual behavior.
      Users who relied on this behavior should check the signs of `rootCertExpirySeconds` and `certChainExpirySeconds` instead.
